card.name: Diluent wording in reconstitution directions
card.fires_on: The word right after a volume and diluent in reconstitution directions, such as 'of' after '5 mL' or 'Injection' after 'Sodium Chloride' or 'Dextrose'. It also fires weakly on punctuation inside source citations.

modes.label: Diluent phrase
modes.description: Linking word or 'Injection' inside instructions to dissolve a vial in a named fluid.
modes.example: Dissolve contents of one 0.5 mg vial with 5 mL<< of>> Sterile Water for Injection, USP

modes.label: Source citation
modes.description: Comma or word inside a parenthetical archive source line.
modes.example: (Source: Institute Archives and Special Collections<<,>> MIT Libraries, Cambridge Massachusetts)

card.plain: It lights up on the small words in vial-mixing directions, such as 'of' or 'Injection' after a fluid name.
